title: Art. 2.24.1 — Annex 11 - Air Traffic Services, Chapter 2 - General, 2.24 Service to aircraft in the event of an emergency, 2.24.1
content:
An aircraft known or believed to be in a state of emergency, including being subjected to unlawful interference, shall be given maximum consideration, assistance and priority over other aircraft as may be necessitated by the circumstances.

Note. To indicate that it is in a state of emergency, an aircraft equipped with an appropriate data link capability and/or an SSR transponder might operate the equipment as follows:

a) on Mode A, Code 7700; or
